description: This file contains partial struct 'Writer<TBufferWriter>' with methods for writing field headers in serialization, and static class 'FieldHeaderCodec' with methods for reading field headers in deserialization, including extended headers and type information handling.

classes.name: FieldHeaderCodec
classes.description: Provides static methods for reading field headers in serialization/deserialization process.

methods.name: WriteFieldHeader
methods.description: Writes a field header with field id, expected type, actual type, and wire type.

methods.name: WriteFieldHeaderExpected
methods.description: Writes an expected field header with field id and wire type.

methods.name: ReadFieldHeader
methods.description: Reads a field header from the input, including extended headers if necessary.

methods.name: ReadFieldHeader
methods.description: Reads a field header and returns the field object.

methods.name: ReadExtendedFieldHeader
methods.description: Reads extended header data for a field, including field id and type.

methods.name: ReadType
methods.description: Reads a type based on schema type, handling well-known, encoded, and referenced types.

methods.name: ReadTypeForAnalysis
methods.description: Reads type information for analysis purposes, returning type and type name.

methods.name: ReadFieldHeaderForAnalysis
methods.description: Reads a field header for diagnostic analysis, returning the field and type info.

methods.name: ReadFieldHeaderForAnalysisSlow
methods.description: Slow path for reading extended field header info for analysis.
